sites.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Artemis III)
sites.description: High-illumination south polar ridge adjacent to permanently shadowed water-ice craters.

sites.name: Mare Tranquillitatis (Apollo 11)
sites.description: Smooth basaltic mare plain where Apollo 11 Eagle touched down on July 20, 1969.

sites.name: Taurus-Littrow Valley (Apollo 17)
sites.description: Deep highland-rimmed graben valley rich in volcanic glass and ancient crustal breccias.
